scope: Offline HTTP loopback, injected timed SSE provider, authenticated v2 gateway and durable SQLite WAL/FULL ledger. No real provider, deployment, office channel or Square calls.

method.meaningful: first non-empty content delta, excluding reservation and reasoning
method.completion: first model call response end including continuation and settlement
method.workflow: three sequential signed child calls with full preserved reasoning/tool replies; includes client signing and JSON work
method.warmup: six batches per concurrency, alternating direct/gateway
method.coldLimit: No process-cold or OS-cache-cold measurement; first-server and database-reopen measurements are labelled separately
method.pairedP95: Differences of route p95 values, not p95 of paired overhead
method.throughput: Not inferred from short synthetic timer chunks; matched live token-throughput measurement remains required
method.seed: Real synthetic settled request/evidence/event rows, not empty filler
method.square: Separate class with no gateway import or call

startup.kind: database reopen in a warm process; includes schema check and ledger hash verification; excludes OS-cold/process-cold startup
